primary_comparison: Gaussian diagnostic classifier: full measured two-point observations versus only end-to-end observation. Deployment-held-out macro F1, accuracy, per-family confusion, coverage and measured impairment verification. Two test deployments cannot support a significance claim.
secondary: Same frozen Gaussian model, offline causal replay of fixed, oldest, and expected-risk optional probe policies. All raw probes actually collected; savings in this replay are counterfactual and must not be presented as live resource savings.
actuation: Private test UE uesimtun0 netem 0-80ms; independent guest application bounded processing wait 0-150ms. No packets forged, no external endpoints, no NF pauses. Application wait controlled on guest management port forwarded only to core 127.0.0.1.
trust: Original AUSF/NSSF CU retained. Both measurement paths verify the same independent-kernel guest Ed25519 receipts; they are not independent signers. Shared physical host and trusted collector clock remain. No hardware attestation.
feature_contract: Measured end-to-end median RTT and measured bypass median RTT only. No family, tick, replica, stage, commanded wait/delay or future observations. First-stage complete-case observation comparison explicitly reports its coverage. Replay eligibility must not depend on unselected bypass responses.
labels: Actuation assignment is evaluation-only ground truth for controlled mechanism, not a label for a malicious attack. Training and primary assessment use predefined steady prefixes from tick22; healthy uses the same positions. All transition/warmup rows and failed-effect trials remain published.
limits: Pilot of two mechanisms plus healthy/combined cases. Bounded artificial service wait is not endogenous queue saturation, semantic attack or production incident. Direct probe is a bypass of UE/AMF/SMF/UPF user-plane path, not an independent security oracle. Online physical adaptive acquisition is not tested. No claim of ML superiority or scientific priority from a positive observability result.
